The '''Mos Espa orphanage''' was a childcare institution in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], the [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

During the [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the orphanage received a donation of 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[TK-555]]. TK-555 who had unknowingly stolen candy destined for poor children felt remorseful, and was pressured into donating to the orphanage by an unidentified [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].
